science.qualification: Color of a black body at the dayside brightness temperature 1,967 K measured in secondary eclipse in the JWST MIRI LRS band, 5.05 to 10.55 µm (Smith et al. 2026 (arXiv preprint, submitted 2026-09-02), dayside brightness temperature in the MIRI LRS bandpass from one partial eclipse 81 ± 16 ppm deep), uniform over the disc and lit by its star so the day side faces it. The planet is unresolved: no map is implied, and reflected starlight is not included.

metadata.limbMeaning: The adopted source-radius opaque-sphere silhouette and prepared phase lighting define the limb; no atmospheric rim is inferred.
